official_source_url.value: https://ambassade-en-france.gouv.mc/en/information-and-services/visiting-monaco — Monaco's own embassy site states Monaco issues no visa of its own: 'Nationals of countries outside the European Economic Area wishing to visit the Principality of Monaco must be in possession of a valid passport and a visa for the Schengen area.'

cross_verification.note_en: Monaco has no independent visa authority or border control; it is folded into the Schengen area via France. Non-EEA nationals needing to visit Monaco must obtain a Schengen visa processed by French consular authorities (france-visas.gouv.fr), confirmed directly on Monaco's own embassy-in-France website. Because there is no Monaco-specific 'visa photo' standard distinct from the general Schengen/ICAO photo rules administered by France, and a direct fetch of france-visas.gouv.fr was blocked (HTTP 403) in this session, no size/background/etc. fields are recorded as verified for this slug — recording DB's existing 3.5×4.5cm/white as confirmed would misrepresent that they were checked against an actual Monaco-issued visa photo standard, which does not exist.
